records.title: Global Futures Scholarship (South Asia) - University of Manchester

official.status_note: The 2027 entry cycle is live: the University is offering more than 350 partial merit-based scholarships worth over GBP 6 million to students starting in September 2027. The online form link is emailed to eligible offer-holders only after an offer is made; both the offer and the completed form are due by 25 April 2027, with outcomes by 1 June 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award will be made as a discount on international tuition fees and no payment will be made to the awardee (2027 terms and conditions).
official.funding_period: one-off discount on published overseas tuition fees
benefits: Award value of GBP 12,000 for high performing students from Bangladesh, Pakistan and Sri Lanka
Awarded as a discount on published overseas tuition fees, with no payment made to the awardee
Automatic consideration through the online application form emailed to all eligible offer-holders
eligibility: Permanent resident (domiciled) in Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka, having predominantly resided there during the last three years; eligibility is based on domicile rather than nationality
International fee-paying student who is self-funded (not sponsored by a government or commercial funder)
Conditional or unconditional offer to study a full-time, on-campus master's course at The University of Manchester starting September 2027, held by 25 April 2027
Bachelor's degree taken within South Asia; minimum second-class upper degree or overseas equivalent; decisions are made on bachelor's degree performance

Not for MBA, MPhil, MEnt, Master of Architecture (MArch), Architecture & Urbanism (MA), Architecture and Digital Design (MA), Master of Landscape Architecture (MLA), PGCE, Clinical Medicine or Dentistry degrees, the listed MSc by Research courses, or blended/distance learning programmes

Cannot be combined with other internal full tuition awards (Equity and Merit, Humanitarian, Women in STEM); GREAT and Global Futures awardees must choose one award; one scholarship application per student; the award cannot be deferred to a later intake
requirements: Apply for the scholarship via the online form by 25 April 2027; the link is emailed to all relevant offer holders
Complete all sections of the application form - incomplete forms will not be considered in the selection process
Hold a minimum of a second-class upper degree or overseas equivalent
documents: Online scholarship application form (link emailed to eligible offer-holders once an offer is made)
Supporting statement within the application form - decisions rest on academic merit and the quality of the supporting statement
Bachelor's degree performance details, which are the basis of the selection decision
selection_criteria: Academic merit, judged on performance in the bachelor's degree
Quality of the supporting statement and online application form
Balance by gender, domicile and course in the allocation of awards, with greater credit given where students from your country are underrepresented on a course
coverage: GBP 12,000 discount on published overseas tuition fees
For courses lasting more than one year, the discount applies to the first year of tuition fees only
application_method: Apply for and receive a conditional or unconditional offer for a full-time, on-campus master's course starting September 2027
Wait for the online scholarship application form, which is emailed to all eligible offer-holders
Submit the completed online form by 25 April 2027
Receive notification of the outcome by 1 June 2027
official.application_route: Secure a Manchester master's offer first, then complete the online scholarship application form emailed by the University to eligible offer-holders
official.study_mode: Full-time, on-campus courses delivered at The University of Manchester's UK campus in Manchester
official.citizenship_residency: Domicile-based: permanent resident of Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka, having predominantly lived there during the last three years; a country lived in only for full-time education does not count
official.international_eligibility: Yes - open to international fee-paying students domiciled in Bangladesh, Pakistan and Sri Lanka
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Excluded: MBA, MPhil, MEnt, MArch, Architecture & Urbanism, Architecture and Digital Design, MLA, PGCE, Clinical Medicine and Dentistry degrees, the Master's by Research courses listed in the terms appendix, and blended or distance learning programmes
official.duration: One-off award; for courses of more than one year the discount applies to first-year tuition fees only
official.description: The University of Manchester offers Global Futures Scholarships of GBP 12,000 to South Asian master's students as partial merit-based awards, granted as a discount on published overseas tuition fees for study starting in September 2027.
official.program_type: Partial merit-based tuition fee scholarship (Global Futures Scholarships - South Asia master's awards)

not_confirmed: english_requirement - no scholarship-specific IELTS/TOEFL score is published; the programme's own English language requirement applies
verification.notes: GBP 12,000 value, tuition-fee discount mechanism, Bangladesh/Pakistan/Sri Lanka domicile rule, 25 April 2027 deadline and 1 June 2027 notification confirmed on the University's Bangladesh and Pakistan country profile pages and the official 2027 terms and conditions PDF (DocID=79917); DocID=73264 is the superseded 2025 round at GBP 8,000.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a GBP 12,000 one-off tuition-fee discount, not a living stipend, so flights, visa costs, insurance and Manchester living expenses remain entirely on you. The window only opens after you hold an offer: Manchester emails the application link to eligible offer-holders, and both your offer and your completed form must be in place by 25 April 2027. Selection leans heavily on your bachelor's performance (minimum 2:1) plus the quality of your supporting statement. Winners hear by 1 June 2027, which leaves roughly a month before typical deposit deadlines, so line up fee funding early.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong 2:1 graduates domiciled in Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka who took their bachelor's degree in South Asia and are self-funding a one-year taught master's
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for your master's course early enough to hold a Manchester offer well before 25 April 2027 - no offer means no scholarship form
Watch for the application link email from the International Office (international@manchester.ac.uk); it goes to relevant offer-holders only
Check your intended course against the exclusion list (MBA, MArch, Architecture & Urbanism, MLA, PGCE, clinical medicine/dentistry and the listed MSc by Research courses)
Draft a focused supporting statement built around your academic record and why the chosen course
Confirm you have predominantly lived in Bangladesh, Pakistan or Sri Lanka for the last three years - domicile, not nationality, decides eligibility
Plan your remaining fee and living-cost funding, since UKVI requires proof you can cover the balance
common_rejection_risks: Submitting an incomplete application form - incomplete forms are excluded from selection entirely
Having taken your bachelor's degree outside South Asia, which makes you ineligible regardless of grades
Never receiving or missing the emailed form because you applied too late to hold an offer by 25 April 2027
Being sponsored or holding another internal full-tuition award, both of which disqualify you or force a choice between awards
Submitting more than one scholarship application across multiple course applications - only the first is considered
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, flights, visa and immigration health surcharge, insurance, and any tuition above the GBP 12,000 discount; on multi-year courses the discount covers first-year tuition only
document_audit: No separate transcript upload is published, but all grade information must be truthful - false information can lead to the award being withdrawn
Domicile is defined by ordinary residence: time spent in the country purely for full-time education does not count toward the three-year requirement
Only your bachelor's degree performance is assessed - postgraduate qualifications cannot rescue a weaker undergraduate record
Multi-year course applicants should note the discount is exhausted after year one when budgeting
alerts: Offer and scholarship form share one deadline: 25 April 2027; outcomes are notified by 1 June 2027
The award cannot be deferred to a later intake cycle if you decide to wait a year
GREAT and Global Futures awards are mutually exclusive - if offered both you must pick one
Successful scholars are expected to act as Global Futures ambassadors, typically up to 8 hours per semester
Programme changes or interruptions of study require prior International Office approval
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for an eligible course, receive an offer, complete the emailed online form before 25 April 2027, and await the decision by 1 June 2027

records.title: GREAT Scholarship for Bangladesh - University of Manchester

official.application_cycle: 2026 entry round (GREAT Scholarships 2026, September 2026 entry); dates for the next annual cycle not yet published
official.status_note: The published 2026 round closed on 23 April 2026 (the application form was emailed to relevant offer-holders from December 2025) with successful applicants notified by 29 May 2026; Manchester has not yet published dates for the following annual cycle.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The University of Manchester GREAT scholarships will be awarded in the form of discount on published overseas tuition fees.
official.funding_period: one-off discount on published overseas tuition fees
benefits: GBP 15,000 for the Bangladesh award - one of three Manchester GREAT scholarships (Bangladesh GBP 15,000, Ghana GBP 18,000, Pakistan GBP 15,000)
Awarded as a discount on published overseas tuition fees, with no payment made to the awardee
Participation in the British Council GREAT Scholarships scheme, including scholar networking events and ambassador activities
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident and citizen (passport holder) of Bangladesh

Bachelor's degree taken in Bangladesh - applicants who completed a higher education qualification outside Bangladesh cannot apply unless the qualification is from The University of Manchester; previous UK study disqualifies unless it was at Manchester
Conditional or unconditional offer to study a full-time, on-campus, one-year taught master's programme at The University of Manchester by 23 April 2026
Self-funded (not sponsored by a government or commercial funder) and classified as international for tuition-fee purposes
Not for MBA, MPhil, MEnt, MArch, Architecture & Urbanism, MLA, PGCE, Clinical Medicine or Dentistry degrees, the listed MSc by Research courses, or blended/distance learning programmes

Cannot be combined with internal full tuition awards such as the Equity and Merit programme or Women in STEM; GREAT and Global Futures awardees must choose one award; one application per student; the award cannot be deferred
requirements: Apply for the scholarship via the online form by 23 April 2026 (2026 round); the link was emailed to relevant offer-holders between December 2025 and the deadline
Complete all sections of the application form - incomplete forms will not be considered in the selection process
Awardees must accept their course offer and pay the CAS deposit by 23 July 2026
Meet the English language requirement of the UK University (set at programme level)
documents: Scholarship application form emailed by the International Office to all relevant offer-holders
Supporting scholarship application - selection is based on academic merit and the quality of the application
Bachelor's degree performance details, which are the basis of the selection decision
selection_criteria: Academic merit, decided on performance in the bachelor's degree (postgraduate qualifications are welcome but only bachelor's degrees are considered)
Awards made on merit, taking into account the University's strategic postgraduate taught teaching priorities
coverage: GBP 15,000 discount on published overseas tuition fees
For courses lasting more than one year the discount applies to first-year tuition fees only; the Bangladesh award is for one-year taught master's programmes
application_method: Apply for an eligible one-year taught master's course and receive a conditional or unconditional offer
Receive the scholarship application form emailed by the International Office to relevant offer-holders
Submit the completed form by the deadline (23 April 2026 for the 2026 round)
Outcomes notified (by 29 May 2026 for the 2026 round); awardees must then accept their offer and pay the CAS deposit by 23 July 2026
official.application_route: Hold a Manchester offer for an eligible one-year taught master's, then submit the scholarship application form emailed by the International Office
official.study_mode: Full-time, on-campus, one-year taught master's programme
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a permanent resident and citizen of Bangladesh (Bangladeshi passport holder)
official.international_eligibility: Yes - open to Bangladeshi international fee-paying students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All on-campus, full-time taught master's programmes except MBA, MPhil, MArch, Architecture & Urbanism, Architecture and Digital Design, MLA, PGCE, Clinical Medicine and Dentistry, and the listed MSc by Research courses; offered in partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign
official.duration: One-year taught master's programme; single award applied as a tuition fee discount
official.description: In partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign, The University of Manchester offers one GREAT Scholarship of GBP 15,000 to a student from Bangladesh for one-year master's programmes, awarded as a discount on published overseas tuition fees.
official.program_type: Partial merit-based tuition fee scholarship under the British Council GREAT Scholarships scheme

not_confirmed: english_requirement - no scholarship-specific IELTS/TOEFL score is published; scholars must meet the programme's own English language requirement
Dates for the next annual cycle after the 2026 round
verification.notes: GBP 15,000 Bangladesh value, single-award count, discount mechanism, 23 April 2026 deadline, 29 May 2026 notification and full eligibility criteria confirmed on the Manchester GREAT scholarships page and the official 2026 eligibility criteria PDF (DocID=77322).

applicant_utility.summary: One GBP 15,000 tuition-fee discount is on the table for a Bangladeshi applicant on a one-year taught master's, run with the British Council under the GREAT scheme. The 2026 round closed on 23 April 2026 with results issued by 29 May 2026, so the practical move now is to watch the Manchester and Study UK pages for the next cycle's dates rather than assume an April deadline will repeat. It pays nothing toward living costs or travel, and it cannot be held alongside a Global Futures award - offered both, you must choose one. Expect an ambassador commitment to both the University and the British Council on top of your studies.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Bangladeshi citizens and residents with a Bangladeshi bachelor's degree heading into a one-year taught master's who want a British Council-linked award
application_readiness_checklist: Hold a conditional or unconditional Manchester offer before the deadline - the form reaches relevant offer-holders only, by email from the International Office
Confirm your course is a one-year, on-campus, full-time taught master's that is not on the excluded list (MBA, MArch, PGCE, clinical medicine/dentistry, listed MSc by Research courses)
Meet the English language requirement of your chosen programme - confirmation of English-medium instruction is not accepted at Manchester
Once awarded, accept your course offer and pay the CAS deposit by 23 July 2026 (earlier for some courses) or the award is withdrawn
Decide in advance between GREAT and Global Futures if you could qualify for both, since holding both is not allowed
Budget for the tuition balance, living costs and visa expenses the discount does not touch
common_rejection_risks: Having previously studied in the UK - only prior study at The University of Manchester keeps you eligible
Taking your bachelor's degree outside Bangladesh (a Manchester qualification is the only exception)
Being sponsored by a government or commercial funder, or holding another internal full-tuition award
Missing the post-award CAS deposit deadline, which withdraws the award after 23 July 2026
An incomplete application form, which is excluded from selection outright
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Manchester living costs, flights, visa fees and immigration health surcharge, insurance, and any tuition above the GBP 15,000 discount
document_audit: No standalone transcript list is published, but grade information must be accurate - false information can lead to withdrawal
Only one scholarship application counts even if you apply for multiple courses
The award is a fee discount only; no cash is paid to you, so plan cash flow for arrival costs independently
Ambassador work (presentations, testimonials, British Council networking) is part of the package, typically up to 8 hours per semester
alerts: The 2026 cycle is closed; the University has not yet published dates for the next round - check the GREAT scholarships page and Study UK before planning around this deadline
The award cannot be deferred to a later intake if your plans slip a year
It may be combined with other partial internal awards but never with full-tuition awards such as Equity and Merit or Women in STEM
UKVI rules require you to show you can fund the remaining tuition and living costs
Programme changes or interruptions need International Office approval
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a one-year master's offer, complete the emailed scholarship form by the published deadline, then accept the offer and pay the CAS deposit within the required window
